name: Tsar Wars
review:
A 6x6 cluster battle where five or more connected symbols win and get destroyed. Symbols come in 1x1, 2x2 and 3x3 sizes, so a big symbol can complete a cluster on its own, and every new avalanche after a win adds x1 to the multiplier.

xBomb and Trapped Wilds help keep sequences going, which is exactly what you want with a multiplier that climbs per avalanche. High volatility, 19,775x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
